text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need a lean battlecard and a matching benchmark narrative for the Q2 launch thread vs cloud AI platforms + infra vendors. Target: short win-ready doc + 1 slide for webinar. Can we own this by Wednesday?
Ajay Patel: I can take the cloud comparisons slice. focusing on latency/cost tradeoffs and routing fallbacks.
Casey Li: I’ll do infra vendors (self-hosted runtimes, ops burden, TCO). Short bullets, not essays.
Frank O'Neil: I’ll stitch the benchmark narrative and run the draft perf chart. Need the raw numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Maria Chen: Perfect. priorities: 1) crisp claim (why Redwood inference vs managed endpoints) 2) 2-3 evidence points (latency, cost per request, reliability fallbacks) 3) quick rebut lines for procurement.
Ajay Patel: For claims, suggest: "Predictable inference economics across hosted, dedicated, private". Short proof: dedicated latency SLA numbers, autoscale profiles, fallback to lighter models.
Casey Li: Rebut line idea for infra vendors: "Build vs buy ops tax" with 2 bullets: infra engineering headcount + unexpected ops incidents.
Frank O'Neil: For perf chart I'll need: p50/p95 token latency for hosted vs dedicated vs self-hosted with same model family, and cost per 1k tokens. If you give ranges I can make a small table.
Maria Chen: I'll add procurement hooks: security, SLAs, private deployment options, KMS. Keep language simple for SDRs.
Ajay Patel: Also add one callout vs LLM APIs: streaming + function-calling parity and transparent model catalog (no surprise model switches).
Casey Li: Draft bullets for infra vendor: migration effort estimate (3 months average for a mid-market app), ops runway, and GPU refresh cycle headaches.
Frank O'Neil: I'll mock chart with placeholder numbers now, mark as "TBD" and annotate where real measurements go. Use this snippet to render quickly:
```
# perf table (csv)
mode,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
hosted,40,120,$0.85
dedicated,30,80,$0.60
self-hosted,45,200,$0.55
```
Maria Chen: Nice. Casey — can you drop short procurement Q&A (3 Qs + 1 liner answers) so SDRs can use them in inbound routing? Example: "What SLA do you need?" -> "We offer SLA-backed dedicated tiers."
Casey Li: On it. Will do 3 Qs: SLA, data residency, egress costs.
Evelyn (ops-bot): Reminder: webinar slot on April 8 is tentatively reserved. Need slide deck by April 1 to get approvals.
Maria Chen: OK double-check timeline: raw perf numbers by tomorrow EOD -> Frank. Draft battlecard bullets by Tue noon -> Ajay/Casey. Slide for webinar by Thu -> Maria/Frank. Finalized doc by Wed next week -> team review.
Ajay Patel: I'll populate cloud competitor snippets in a shared doc: https://tiny.redwood/comp-snippets (pls add comments inline).
Casey Li: Adding infra rebut lines now. Will ping when done.
Frank O'Neil: Uploaded initial mock chart to drive: https://tiny.redwood/perf-mock and tagged Maria.
Maria Chen: Great progress. Final ask: keep the deck + battlecard concise — one pager + one slide. SDRs should be able to skim in 60s. :thumbsup:
Ajay Patel: Affirmative. I'll make bullets scannable, and include one-liner soundbites for SDRs.
Casey Li: Done — pushed a short Q&A and migration bullet points.
Maria Chen: Thanks. We'll regroup after Frank updates numbers. If anything slips, ping here.
Frank O'Neil: Updated numbers uploaded at 4312345699, flagged as provisional.
Maria Chen: Received — thanks everyone. I'll assemble final and share for 24h review.
